# Documentation

## README & Feature Docs
- Each feature folder must include a `README.md` describing purpose, public APIs, run/test instructions, and examples.

## API Documentation
- Use XML comments in C# and ensure Swagger/OpenAPI is generated and published.

## Inline Documentation
- Use JSDoc for TypeScript public APIs. Comments should explain "why" not "what".

## Onboarding
- Provide a short getting-started section with commands to build, test, and run the app locally.
